behavior.name: complete_grounded_blocker_comparison
behavior.definition: The assistant must use the approved dataset to compare the team with the most blocked items against the team with the highest blocker rate, state whether the same team leads both measures, and explain the conclusion with both underlying values.

definition_of_terms.definition: The count of delivery work items whose status is blocked.
The percentage of a team's delivery work items that are blocked.

behavior_categories.name: grounded_blocker_comparison
behavior_categories.definition: Use fresh dataset evidence to compare both blocker count and blocker rate and connect both values to the conclusion.
examples: Use the approved dataset to determine whether the team with the most blocked items also has the highest blocker rate, and explain with both values.
